opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from an origin to a destination with depart/return dates (or one-way), then sort/filter results.
steps: Type origin in From and select suggestion
Type destination in To and select suggestion
Choose trip type (roundtrip/one-way)
Pick depart (and return) dates in calendar
Click Search flights
Continue to flight results
Open Sort & Filter, choose sort (price low to high) and Apply

instances.values: New York -> Toronto, one-way, depart 29, sort price low to high

opportunities.name: Budget careers job search with filters
opportunities.description: On Budget careers openings, filter by country, team, and time type, then search and open a job.
steps: Click Careers then Openings
Click Country, search and select country
Click Team, search and select team
Click Time Type, search and select type
Click Search by job title or keyword
Open a job listing

instances.values: USA, Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search United car rentals by pickup location and pickup/drop-off dates and times.
steps: Click CAR tab
Enter pickup city/airport and select suggestion
Click Pickup and choose start and end dates
Optionally set pickup and drop-off times
Click Find cars

opportunities.name: NPS find a park by activity/topic
opportunities.description: Use NPS Find a Park, search by activity or topic, choose a category and search.
steps: Click FIND A PARK
Click Search by Activity or Topic
Choose Activity or Topic button
Select value in input
Click Search
